title: 质粒转化与合成生物学
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/181_质粒转化与合成生物学.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/181_质粒转化与合成生物学/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一个彩色珠子串成的质粒环模型
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a ring shaped plasmid model made of colored beads beside a laptop showing a simple curve, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第15章第十九课：质粒转化与合成生物学。
overlay: 质粒转化与合成生物学

shots.scene: 阿杰想把转化的平板带回宿舍给室友看
shots.prompt_en: The young male student slips a glowing petri dish into his backpack at the lab door, a red warning icon.
shots.narration: 阿杰想把发光平板带回宿舍炫一下。

shots.scene: 王老师拦住：转基因材料不能带出
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator stops him at the door and points to a biohazard waste bin and a sealed autoclave bag.
shots.narration: 王老师：转基因材料，一律不出实验室。

shots.scene: 小研：先懂原理，再按审批和规程做
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in a lab coat holds a protocol sheet and a plasmid model, nodding. The sheet is blank.
shots.narration: 小研：懂原理，守审批，规范做。

shots.scene: 把基因从一种生物转到另一种
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gene icon moving from one organism icon to another with the help of a small DNA ring carrier. No text.
shots.narration: 遗传转化：把基因转到另一种生物里。

shots.scene: 得到外来基因的叫转基因生物
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an organism with a new gene highlighted inside, a badge icon. No text.
shots.narration: 得到外来基因的生物，叫转基因生物。

shots.scene: 转化是遗传修饰的一种方法
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a toolbox of genetic modification methods with the transformation tool highlighted, an engineered DNA carrier icon. No text.
shots.narration: 借人工改造的DNA运送，是遗传修饰方法之一。

shots.scene: 例：分解溢油、抗虫、产药用蛋白
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a bacterium eating an oil droplet, a crop leaf resisting a pest, a bacterium producing a medicine protein. No text.
shots.narration: 例如分解溢油的菌、抗虫作物、产药菌。

shots.scene: 质粒：染色体外的环状DNA
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bacterial cell with a large chromosome and a few small separate DNA rings. No text.
shots.narration: 质粒是染色体外的环状DNA。

shots.scene: 能自我复制，不干扰宿主
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one small DNA ring copying itself into two inside a cell, the chromosome untouched. No text.
shots.narration: 它能自我复制，不干扰宿主染色体。

shots.scene: 限制酶剪开，插入新基因
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: scissors cutting the DNA ring open, a new gene segment inserted, the ring closing again. No text.
shots.narration: 用限制性内切酶剪开，插入新基因。

shots.scene: 细菌摄取质粒，基因表达
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bacterium taking up a small DNA ring and then making a new protein. No text.
shots.narration: 细菌摄取质粒，上面的基因就能表达。

shots.scene: 感受态细胞：更容易接收DNA
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: bacteria with slightly opened cell walls ready to take up DNA rings, a snowflake icon beside the tube. No text.
shots.narration: 感受态细胞更容易接收质粒。

shots.scene: 【实拍】感受态管插在冰上
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of gloved hands placing small closed tubes into a box of crushed ice on a bench.
shots.narration: 感受态细胞全程放冰上，轻拿轻放。

shots.scene: 热激：冷热骤变帮DNA进入
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tube moving from an ice box to a warm bath and back to ice, a DNA ring entering a cell. No text.
shots.narration: 热激：冷热骤变，帮质粒进入细胞。

shots.scene: 加培养液复苏，再涂平板
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: recovery medium added to the tube, a short incubation icon, then cells spread on a plate. No text.
shots.narration: 加培养液复苏，再涂到选择平板上。

shots.scene: 【实拍】无菌涂布棒涂布
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a gloved hand gently spreading with a sterile disposable spreader on an empty sterile agar plate, the lid held close.
shots.narration: 无菌涂布，按无菌操作要求。

shots.scene: 教学用发光质粒：两个基因
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a teaching plasmid ring with a green glow gene and an antibiotic resistance gene marked by icons. No text.
shots.narration: 教学质粒带两个基因：发光和抗氨苄。

shots.scene: 阿拉伯糖开启发光基因
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sugar molecule acting like a key turning on the glow gene switch. No text.
shots.narration: 发光基因要靠阿拉伯糖来开启。

shots.scene: 受体菌：无害的实验室菌株
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lab strain bacterium with a safe check badge next to a disease causing bacterium crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 受体菌是无害的实验室大肠杆菌菌株。

shots.scene: 没被转化的，遇氨苄就死
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an untransformed bacterium fading out on an antibiotic plate. No text.
shots.narration: 没被转化的菌，遇到氨苄就活不了。

shots.scene: 【实拍】给四块平板做标记
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a gloved hand writing small marks on the bottom edges of four sterile petri dishes.
shots.narration: 四块平板，先写预测再看结果。

shots.scene: 先写预测和理由，再对答案
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a notebook with four blank prediction boxes, a question mark for growth and a question mark for glow. No text.
shots.narration: 会长吗？会发光吗？写下预测和理由。

shots.scene: 平板1：长满菌，不发光
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: plate one covered with many colonies, none glowing. No text.
shots.narration: 平板1：普通培养基，长满菌不发光。

shots.scene: 平板2：加氨苄无质粒，不长
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: plate two with antibiotic and no colonies at all. No text.
shots.narration: 平板2：有氨苄没质粒，一个不长。

shots.scene: 平板3：少量菌落，不发光
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: plate three with a few colonies, not glowing, a missing key icon. No text.
shots.narration: 平板3：少数转化菌长出，缺糖不发光。

shots.scene: 平板4：少量菌落发绿光
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: plate four with a few colonies glowing green under a blue light. No text.
shots.narration: 平板4：再加阿拉伯糖，菌落发绿光。

shots.scene: 转基因实验先风险评估
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gene ring and a bacterium under a magnifier with a risk matrix and a checklist. No text.
shots.narration: 转基因实验，开工前先做风险评估。

shots.scene: 报生物安全委员会审批或备案
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an application document going up to a committee table, a stamp of approval returned. No text.
shots.narration: 按规定报学校生物安全委员会审批。

shots.scene: 菌株质粒登记，领用归还有记录
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a freezer box of strain and plasmid tubes with blank labels, a logbook with a pen. No text.
shots.narration: 菌株、质粒登记，领用归还有记录。

shots.scene: 不擅自改方案、换元件
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a protocol with an unauthorized change crossed out, a review arrow back to the committee. No text.
shots.narration: 改方案、换元件，先重新评估审批。

shots.scene: 抗性基因不能扩散到环境
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a resistance gene icon kept inside a lab boundary, an arrow out to a river crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 抗性基因不能扩散到环境中。

shots.scene: 在指定区域操作，平板不带出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a designated work area sign with plates kept inside, a plate in a backpack crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 在指定区域操作，平板菌液不带出。

shots.scene: 实验服手套不出门
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lab coat hung on a hook and gloves dropped in a waste bin at the lab door, a person leaving with hands washed. No text.
shots.narration: 实验服手套留在室内，洗手再离开。

shots.scene: 洒了先消毒，再报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small spill covered with paper towels and disinfectant, then a report arrow to the lab supervisor. No text.
shots.narration: 菌液洒了，先覆盖消毒，再报告。

shots.scene: 【实拍】废平板装进高压灭菌袋
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of gloved hands placing used petri dishes into an autoclave bag inside a biohazard bin.
shots.narration: 用过的平板、吸头，装进灭菌袋。

shots.scene: 高压灭菌灭活后再处置
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an autoclave cycle icon, then the treated bag going into the designated waste stream. No text.
shots.narration: 高压灭菌灭活后，再按规定处置。

shots.scene: 液体培养物先灭活，不倒水槽
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flask of liquid culture treated in an autoclave, a sink drain crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 菌液先灭活，绝不直接倒水槽。

shots.scene: 记录灭活和处置
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a waste log sheet with a check mark and a date icon. No text.
shots.narration: 灭活和处置都要记录。

shots.scene: 先建模设计，再进实验室
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laptop with a model curve and an arrow pointing to a lab bench. No text.
shots.narration: 合成生物学：先建模设计，再进实验室。

shots.scene: 进不了实验室，正好学建模
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student studies a model curve on a laptop at a desk, a closed lab door in the background.
shots.narration: 进不了实验室的日子，正好学建模。

shots.scene: 楼房模型、模式生物都是模型
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an architect's small building model and a small zebra fish as a model organism. No text.
shots.narration: 楼房模型、模式生物，都是模型。

shots.scene: 模型：代表另一个系统
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a simple icon standing in for a complex system, connected by a dashed arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 模型，就是代表另一个系统的东西。

shots.scene: 示意图：元件怎么相互作用
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: boxes and arrows showing parts activating and repressing each other. No text.
shots.narration: 第一类：示意图，画出元件关系。

shots.scene: 反应式：物质怎么转化
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a chemical reaction line with arrows from reactants to products. No text.
shots.narration: 第二类：生化反应式，讲物质转化。

shots.scene: 微分方程：数量随时间变
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a curve rising over time on a graph, a small equation icon beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 第三类：常微分方程，算数量随时间变。

shots.scene: 质量作用定律：反应式写成方程
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a reaction line turning into a rate equation through an arrow with a balance icon. No text.
shots.narration: 用质量作用定律，把反应式写成方程。

shots.scene: 先做实验再凑模型，不可取
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bridge collapsing and being rebuilt again and again, a wasted money icon, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 像造桥塌了再造，太浪费。

shots.scene: 设计、构建、测试，循环
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a circular loop of three stages, a pencil for design, a wrench for build, a gauge for test. No text.
shots.narration: 工程做法：设计、构建、测试循环。

shots.scene: 设计建模、构建克隆、测试校准
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the loop with a model curve in design, assembling DNA blocks in build, and a calibrated reader in test. No text.
shots.narration: 设计时模拟，构建时组装，测试时校准测量。

shots.scene: 结果不理想，回到再设计
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a test result below target with an arrow looping back to the design stage. No text.
shots.narration: 结果不理想，就回到再设计。

shots.scene: 预测输出，挑选元件
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a model predicting several circuit outputs, the best part option highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 建模能预测输出，指导挑选元件。

shots.scene: 找出影响最大的变量
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: several sliders, one causing a big change in the output curve, highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 改一个元件看整体，找出关键变量。

shots.scene: 省时间、省经费、降风险
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clock, a coin and a shield icon with check marks. No text.
shots.narration: 先在模型里排障，省时省钱。

shots.scene: 模型不能代替安全评估
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a model screen with an equals sign to a risk assessment form crossed out, both needed. No text.
shots.narration: 模型再好，也不能代替安全评估。

shots.scene: DNA转录成mRNA，再翻译成蛋白
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a DNA strand making an mRNA strand, then a ribosome making a protein chain. No text.
shots.narration: 中心法则：转录成mRNA，再翻译成蛋白。

shots.scene: 启动子、RBS、编码区、终止子
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a DNA line with four colored blocks in order, an arrow block, a small block, a long block and a stop block. No text.
shots.narration: 启动子、RBS、编码序列、终止子。

shots.scene: 元件组成器件和系统
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: small parts snapping together into a device, devices into a system. No text.
shots.narration: 元件组成转录单元，再组成系统。

shots.scene: 组成型：一直开着
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gene switch always in the on position, a steady output line. No text.
shots.narration: 组成型表达：基因一直开着。

shots.scene: 受调控：转录因子开或关
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a transcription factor icon turning a gene switch on and another turning it off. No text.
shots.narration: 受调控表达：转录因子激活或抑制。

shots.scene: 像水箱：进水是生成，漏水是降解
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a water tank with an inflow tap labeled by an icon and an outflow hole, the level settling. No text.
shots.narration: 生成像进水，降解像漏水。

shots.scene: 进出平衡，数量稳定
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the tank level rising and then becoming flat when inflow equals outflow. No text.
shots.narration: 生成和降解平衡，数量就稳定了。

shots.scene: 准稳态：快反应先算平衡
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a fast mRNA step marked at balance, two equations merging into one. No text.
shots.narration: 转录快，可近似平衡，方程化简成一个。

shots.scene: 复杂电路化简，要知道丢了什么
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a large set of reactions reduced to a small set, a note icon showing what was left out. No text.
shots.narration: 复杂电路能化简，但要清楚丢了什么。

shots.scene: 参数查数据库，记下出处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a database icon with literature values and a citation note icon. No text.
shots.narration: 参数可查生物学数据库，记下出处。

shots.scene: mRNA几分钟，荧光蛋白约九十分钟
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two half life bars, a short one for mRNA and a long one for a fluorescent protein. No text.
shots.narration: mRNA半衰期几分钟，荧光蛋白约90分钟。

shots.scene: 换RBS就是改翻译速率
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the same promoter with a strong and a weak ribosome binding site, two output levels. No text.
shots.narration: 换强弱不同的RBS，就是改翻译速率。

shots.scene: 定时测荧光，拟合参数
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: measured fluorescence dots over time fitted by a model curve, a dose response curve beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 定时测荧光，和模型对比，估出参数。

shots.scene: 激活子越多，转录越强
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an S shaped rising curve of output versus activator amount. No text.
shots.narration: 激活子越多转录越强，呈S形曲线。

shots.scene: 半浓度常数与希尔系数
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the S curve with a half way point marked and a steeper curve beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 希尔系数越大，开关越陡，多在1到4。

shots.scene: 阻遏子越多，表达越低
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a falling S curve of output versus repressor amount, a small floor level remaining. No text.
shots.narration: 阻遏子越多表达越低，最低还会漏一点。

shots.scene: 没有激活子时的表达叫基础表达
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the S curve starting from a small nonzero level at zero activator, that level highlighted. No text.
shots.narration: 没有激活子时的表达，叫基础表达。

shots.scene: 荧光蛋白做报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: cells glowing in several colors, excitation and emission spectrum curves beside them. No text.
shots.narration: 荧光蛋白是好报告，按光谱挑颜色。

shots.scene: 绿色荧光蛋白来自水母
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glowing jellyfish and a green fluorescent protein barrel shape, other colored variants beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 绿色荧光蛋白来自水母，颜色种类很多。

shots.scene: 荧光标准品换算分子数
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a calibration curve from a fluorescent standard converting a reading into molecule counts. No text.
shots.narration: 用荧光标准品，把读数换成分子数。

shots.scene: 微球校准光密度，算单细胞
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: tiny bead particles calibrating an optical density reading into cell counts, a division sign. No text.
shots.narration: 微球校准光密度，算出每个细胞的量。

shots.scene: 校准结果带回设计
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: calibrated data flowing back into the design stage of the loop. No text.
shots.narration: 校准测量把结果带回设计，闭合循环。

shots.scene: 数据模型像黑箱，要大量数据
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a black box with many data points going in and predictions coming out. No text.
shots.narration: 机器学习像黑箱，需要大量数据。

shots.scene: 机理模型能解释原因
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a transparent box showing gears inside, an explanation light bulb. No text.
shots.narration: 机理模型从原理出发，能解释原因。

shots.scene: 两种方法各有用处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a black box and a transparent gear box side by side on a balance, a data stack choosing between them. No text.
shots.narration: 两种方法各有用处，看手里的数据。

shots.scene: 转化：质粒、选择平板、无菌
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a plasmid ring, four plates and a sterile loop, all checked. No text.
shots.narration: 质粒转化：选择平板，无菌操作。

shots.scene: 审批、记录、灭活、不带出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an approval stamp, a logbook, an autoclave and a door with a crossed out plate. No text.
shots.narration: 先审批，有记录，灭活处置，不带出。

shots.scene: 建模：设计—构建—测试
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the design build test loop with a model curve and calibrated data. No text.
shots.narration: 建模助设计，但不代替安全评估。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一块被清理干净的土壤和小苗
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to a small tray of clean soil with a young green seedling, tiny friendly microbe icons around it, waving goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：生物修复与生物技术应用。
